daily.brief: 從11月13日晚間到15日凌晨，市場有490則帖、135個帳號在討論。最大焦點仍是$NVDA，165則帖裡看淡帳號明顯多過看好（16對6），但有人強調記憶體短缺正重塑需求，SRAM與HBM都受惠。最乾淨的共識是RKLB（5個看好、零看淡）同AMD（4個），NBIS也有人畫出通往1000美元的路徑。QQQ則有4個帳號看淡，指出跌破200日線的風險。
daily.full:
共識

RKLB是這段最乾淨的共識，5個帳號看好、沒有看淡，11則帖。@itschrisray說不可否認未來有多光明，從未如此看多。原帖。@InvestmentGuru_指出它擁有太空競賽的一份，從發射公司轉向太空基礎設施，Electron定期飛行，Neutron預計2027年首飛，Iridium交易進入衛星業務，上季收入超預期。原帖。@SpaceInvestor_D恭喜達到100。原帖。

AMD有4個帳號一致看好，20則帖。@StockSavvyShay提到AI記憶體短缺最瘋狂的一點是普通DRAM每GB成本現已高於HBM，SRAM用於CBRS與NVDA，HBM由SKHY、MU、三星供應。原帖。@MikeZaccardi引述Lisa Su正成為行業潛在的AI教母，AMD快速擴展在超大規模雲端和領先AI實驗室的足跡。原帖。@InvestmentGuru_說AMD是數據中心計算的第二來源，上季收入增長45%，下一季指引約170億美元。原帖。

NBIS有3個帳號看好，25則帖。@JonahLupton認為無論開放、封閉或混合模型贏家，NBIS都會表現良好，開放模型不會消失。原帖。@ACInvestorBlog畫出通往1000美元的路徑，目前約115美元、市值約340億，達1000需280–3000億市值或8-9倍，2026年營收約30–32億。原帖。

共同看淡

QQQ有4個帳號看淡，22則帖。@BennettWoodman指出納斯達克呈現第三階段頂部轉入第四階段下跌的形態，注意最後喘息反彈可能套住抄底者。原帖。@market_sleuth提到納斯達克100再次跌破200日移動平均線，自互聯網泡沫以來每次反彈失敗後3個月內至少下跌3.8%。原帖。

AAPL有2個帳號看淡。@PhotonBull覺得昂貴、無創新且無AI，可能是避險，AI交易回歸或結束都會傷害它。原帖。

分歧

NVDA是絕對主角，165則帖，看好6個帳號、看淡16個。@StockSavvyShay強調記憶體短缺重塑市場，SRAM用於CBRS與NVDA。原帖。@The_AI_Investor批評有人寫書後轉向負面。原帖。@TrendSpider說先別急著埋葬多頭。原帖。看淡聲音仍較多。

SPCX偏多但有交鋒，6個看好對3個看淡，28則帖。@InvestmentGuru_提到Starship加Starlink，本週第二次到達軌道並放上26顆衛星，今天有首次船隻捕捉嘗試。原帖。@elonmusk說未來Starship飛行將攜帶超過50 Tb/s的Starlink帶寬到軌道。原帖。

MU有4對1，14則帖，記憶體短缺是主軸。@InvestmentGuru_說記憶體是AI的安靜瓶頸，MU向短缺銷售DRAM和NAND。原帖。

其他值得留意

CBRS有3個帳號看好，因指引上調在五個交易日上漲33%。DRAM有大買家買入30,000張四月57美元認購期權，價格2.86美元，近1000萬美元押注記憶體明年初反彈。原帖。NU因獲得巴西銀行牌照獲看好。
daily.html:
短摘要

NVDA 165則帖中看淡聲音多過看好（16對6），但有人強調記憶體短缺利好相關鏈。RKLB 5個帳號共識看好，AMD 4個，NBIS有通往1000美元的路徑討論。QQQ 4個帳號看淡。490則帖、135個帳號。

weekly.brief: 過去7日（11月9日至15日）有1351則帖、211個帳號。AMD持續是最明確的共識看好，14個帳號沒有看淡。AMAT、RKLB也有支持。NVDA仍是最大熱點（581則帖）但14對31意見分裂，看淡較多。SMCI是較清楚的看淡名字。
weekly.full:
共識

AMD在這週持續獲看好，14個帳號明確支持，零看淡，57則帖。AMAT 9個、RKLB 6個、NU 4個、ONDS 4個。整體AI相關芯片和太空名字有多個帳號站在多頭。

共同看淡

SMCI有3個帳號看淡。IWM有3個，GLD、IBIT各2個。部分指數和商品有較一致的負面看法。

分歧

NVDA依舊最大分歧，581則帖，看好14個、看淡31個。SPCX 14對4，CBRS 14對1，CSCO 10對1，SPY 9對1，NBIS 7對2。有人認為AI資本支出故事未變；有人擔心短期事件和估值。

其他值得留意

GOOGL、KO也有共識看好。整體AI和太空主題延續，但短期情緒被NVDA相關新聞干擾。
weekly.html:

一週內AMD是最明確的共識看好（14個帳號），NVDA大分歧持續（14對31）。1351則帖中SMCI被點名看淡。

monthly.brief: 過去28日（10月19日至11月15日）有5971則帖、272個帳號，討論量最大。AMD、SOFI等有較強共識看好，RDDT有10個帳號看淡。大市NVDA、SPCX、SPY意見分裂嚴重，INTC偏空聲音較多。AI主題仍是主軸，但個別公司事件和估值分歧明顯。
monthly.full:

AMD長期仍獲支持，16個帳號看好。SOFI有9個，AMAT 9個，SKHY 7個。一些消費和防禦股如MA、LLY也有共識。整體有多個共識看好名字。

共同看淡

RDDT有10個帳號看淡。BA 5個、FTNT、BABA各3個。部分科技和消費名字有較一致的負面看法。

分歧

NVDA是最大分歧之一，886則帖，看好20個、看淡31個。SPCX 28對9，SPY 22對12，TSLA 20對4。有人認為AI資本支出故事未變，短期恐懼會過去；有人擔心估值和個別風險。INTC偏空（7對17），MU也有交鋒。

其他值得留意

CRDO、RSP等持續有討論。市場輪動和個股事件影響較大，28日數據顯示共識和分歧同時存在。

今日重點

NVDA 165則帖中看淡帳號多過看好（16對6），但有人強調AI記憶體短缺正重塑需求，SRAM與HBM鏈受惠。RKLB獲5個帳號共識看好，從發射轉向太空基礎設施；AMD 4個帳號支持；NBIS有人討論目前約115美元通往1000美元的路徑。QQQ有4個帳號看淡，指跌破200日線風險。

一週和一個月來看，AMD共識較強，大市和AI龍頭則持續分歧。短期看淡聲音集中在個別技術形態。

daily.brief: From the evening of Nov 13 to early morning of Nov 15, there were 490 posts from 135 accounts. The biggest focus remains $NVDA with 165 posts where bearish accounts clearly outnumber bullish ones (16 vs 6), though some stress the memory shortage is reshaping demand and both SRAM and HBM benefit. The cleanest consensus is RKLB (5 bullish, zero bearish) and AMD (4), while someone sketched a path to $1000 for NBIS. QQQ has 4 accounts bearish, noting the risk of breaking the 200-day.
daily.full:
Consensus

RKLB is the cleanest consensus, 5 accounts bullish with none bearish, 11 posts. @itschrisray says the future is undeniably bright and has never been this bullish. original post. @InvestmentGuru_ notes it owns a piece of the space race, shifting from launch company to space infrastructure: Electron flying regularly, Neutron first flight expected 2027, Iridium deal enters satellite business, last quarter revenue beat. original post. @SpaceInvestor_D congratulates reaching 100. original post.

AMD has 4 accounts in agreement, 20 posts. @StockSavvyShay notes the craziest part of the AI memory shortage is that commodity DRAM cost per GB is now higher than HBM; SRAM for CBRS and NVDA, HBM supplied by SKHY, MU, Samsung. original post. @MikeZaccardi quotes that Lisa Su is becoming the potential AI godmother of the industry as AMD rapidly expands its footprint with hyperscalers and leading AI labs. original post. @InvestmentGuru_ says AMD is the second source for data center compute, last quarter revenue grew 45%, next quarter guide around $17B. original post.

NBIS has 3 bullish accounts, 25 posts. @JonahLupton believes NBIS will do well whether the winner is open, closed, or hybrid models; open models are not going away. original post. @ACInvestorBlog sketches a path to $1,000; currently around $115 with ~$34B market cap, reaching $1,000 needs $280–300B or 8-9x, 2026 revenue ~$3.0–3.2B. original post.

Joint Bearish

QQQ has 4 bearish accounts, 22 posts. @BennettWoodman notes Nasdaq shows a stage 3 top transitioning to stage 4 decline; watch the last gasp rally that may trap dip buyers. original post. @market_sleuth notes Nasdaq 100 broke below the 200-day MA again; since the internet bubble, every failed bounce has led to at least a 3.8% decline within 3 months. original post.

AAPL has 2 bearish accounts. @PhotonBull calls it expensive, no innovation, no AI, possibly a safe haven that gets hurt either way. original post.

Divergence

NVDA is the absolute protagonist with 165 posts, 6 bullish and 16 bearish accounts. @StockSavvyShay stresses the memory shortage is reshaping the market. original post. @The_AI_Investor criticizes the author who turned negative after writing a book. original post. @TrendSpider says don't bury the bulls yet. original post. Bearish voices still dominate.

SPCX leans bullish with some back-and-forth, 6 vs 3, 28 posts. @InvestmentGuru_ mentions Starship plus Starlink, second time to orbit this week with 26 satellites, first ship catch attempt today. original post. @elonmusk says future Starship flights will carry over 50 Tb/s of Starlink bandwidth to orbit. original post.

MU has 4 vs 1, 14 posts, memory shortage is the theme. @InvestmentGuru_ says memory is AI's quiet bottleneck. original post.

Other Noteworthy

CBRS has 3 bullish accounts after a guidance raise that sent it up 33% in five trading days. DRAM saw a large buyer of 30,000 April $57 calls at $2.86, nearly $10 million betting on a memory rebound early next year. original post. NU bullish on receiving the Brazilian banking license.
daily.html:
Short Summary

NVDA 165 posts with more bearish than bullish accounts (16 vs 6), though some stress the memory shortage benefits the chain. RKLB 5 accounts in consensus bullish, AMD 4, NBIS has path-to-$1000 discussion. QQQ 4 accounts bearish. 490 posts from 135 accounts.

weekly.brief: Over the past 7 days (Nov 9 to 15) there were 1351 posts from 211 accounts. AMD remains the clearest consensus bullish with 14 accounts and zero bearish. AMAT and RKLB also have support. NVDA is still the biggest hotspot (581 posts) but split 14 vs 31 with more bearish. SMCI is a clearer bearish name.
weekly.full:
Consensus

AMD continued to be favored this week, 14 accounts clearly supportive with zero bearish, 57 posts. AMAT 9, RKLB 6, NU 4, ONDS 4. Overall AI-related chips and space names have multiple accounts on the long side.

Joint Bearish

SMCI has 3 bearish accounts. IWM has 3, GLD and IBIT 2 each. Some indices and commodities have more consistent negative views.

Divergence

NVDA remains the biggest split, 581 posts, 14 bullish vs 31 bearish. SPCX 14 vs 4, CBRS 14 vs 1, CSCO 10 vs 1, SPY 9 vs 1, NBIS 7 vs 2. Some see the AI capex story unchanged; others worry about near-term events and valuation.

Other Noteworthy

GOOGL and KO also have consensus bullish. The AI and space themes continue, but near-term sentiment is interrupted by NVDA-related news.
weekly.html:
Short Summary

Over the week AMD is the clearest consensus bullish (14 accounts), NVDA large divergence continues (14 vs 31). Among 1351 posts SMCI is noted as bearish.

monthly.brief: Over the past 28 days (Oct 19 to Nov 15) there were 5971 posts from 272 accounts, the largest discussion volume. AMD, SOFI etc. have stronger consensus bullish, RDDT has 10 accounts bearish. Large names NVDA, SPCX, SPY are heavily split, INTC has more bearish voices. AI theme remains central but individual company events and valuation divergences are clear.
monthly.full:
Consensus

AMD still has long-term support, 16 accounts bullish. SOFI 9, AMAT 9, SKHY 7. Some consumer and defensive names like MA, LLY also have consensus. Overall multiple consensus bullish names.

Joint Bearish

RDDT has 10 accounts bearish. BA 5, FTNT and BABA 3 each. Some tech and consumer names have more consistent negative views.

Divergence

NVDA is one of the biggest splits, 886 posts, 20 bullish vs 31 bearish. SPCX 28 vs 9, SPY 22 vs 12, TSLA 20 vs 4. Some believe the AI capex story is unchanged and short-term fears will pass; others worry about valuation and individual risks. INTC leans bearish (7 vs 17), MU also has back-and-forth.

Other Noteworthy

CRDO, RSP etc. continue to be discussed. Market rotation and individual stock events have larger impact; the 28-day data shows consensus and divergence coexisting.

briefing.html:
Today's Highlights

NVDA 165 posts with more bearish accounts than bullish (16 vs 6), though some stress the AI memory shortage is reshaping demand and the SRAM/HBM chain benefits. RKLB has 5 accounts in consensus bullish, shifting from launch to space infrastructure; AMD has 4 accounts supportive; NBIS has discussion of a path from ~$115 to $1000. Looking at the week and month, AMD consensus is stronger while large names and AI leaders continue to diverge. Near-term bearish voices concentrate on individual technical patterns.
